propositions: A single declarative metric registry must exist mapping each metric id to lens, data source, and compute function, enabling the command to render complete metrics without modification as new signals are added.
Metrics with no data yet must return Unavailable state carrying non-empty reason and ISO accruing_since timestamp rather than being absent from output.

Every metric value must carry source and confidence labels, where source is one of {structural, git, sidecar, snapshot, backfill_classified} and confidence is one of {high, classified}, to enable downstream aggregation to segregate authoritative data from fuzzy backfills.

The is_authoritative(source) helper must return False for backfill_classified sources, and authoritative aggregation must exclude classified values to prevent non-structural data from polluting authoritative series.
The REGISTRY must enforce structural integrity: every entry has unique id, populated lens, source, and confidence fields, validated by unit tests asserting id uniqueness and field presence.
